title.zh: 规定对违反森林法规所收取的全部罚款与附加费在国民政府与相关市、市镇或市镇区之间平均分配的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for An Equal Distribution Between the National Government and the City, Municipality or Municipal District Concerned, of All Fines and Surcharges Collected for Violations of Forest Laws and Regulations
title.orig: An Act Providing for An Equal Distribution Between the National Government and the City, Municipality or Municipal District Concerned, of All Fines and Surcharges Collected for Violations of Forest Laws and Regulations

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1949/ra_371_1949.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, in all cases of violation of forest laws and regulations, one-half of the fine or surcharge impose shall accrue to the general fund of the National Government, and the other half, to the general fund of the municipality or municipal district where the violate was committed and the fine or surcharge collected.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 14, 1949.
